notes: v606 — THE CARD'S FLOOR BUTTONS SAID THE QUIET PART OUT LOUD. Tony asked which of the five 💧 turnover buttons on the report card covers the whole market — and the honest answer turned out to be that none of them differ any more. Since the one-ruler redesign, every line is measured once, unconditionally, on the \$250k universe; this card's own copy never caught up and was still claiming the choice changes what gets measured, and that changing it re-runs the report. Neither was true. The buttons now say plainly what they actually do: pick which shares you SEE in this card's own lists — the measurement itself never moves, and switching is instant. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
